services.title: Web Development
services.shortDescription: A fast, custom-built website that helps your business load quicker, rank higher, and convert more visitors.
services.valueProp: A site built from scratch around your content and goals, engineered for speed and search visibility from the first commit.
services.problem: As a business grows, a template-based site can start holding it back, with slower load times and rigid layouts that limit how well it ranks and converts.
deliverables: Performance budget enforced at every layer
approach: Discovery & content audit
IA and wireframes
Build in a typed, component-based stack
Performance and accessibility QA
Launch and handover

services.title: Mobile App Development
services.shortDescription: A native-feeling iOS and Android app that keeps your customers engaged wherever they are.
services.valueProp: A mobile app scoped to match your actual reach and budget: cross-platform where it fits, native where performance calls for it.
services.problem: Choosing between cross-platform and native affects your cost, timeline, and performance, so it helps to have that tradeoff explained clearly before you commit.
deliverables: App Store and Google Play submission support
approach: Platform and architecture decision (cross-platform vs native)
UX flows and prototyping
Development in sprints with staging builds
Device and OS-version QA
Store submission and launch

services.title: Custom Systems (CMS / ERP)
services.shortDescription: Internal tools and systems shaped around how your team already works, so day-to-day operations run smoother.
services.valueProp: A system shaped to your actual workflow, replacing spreadsheets and rigid off-the-shelf software with something built for how your team operates.
services.problem: Off-the-shelf CMS and ERP software often means bending your process to fit the tool, leading to workarounds and shadow spreadsheets.
approach: Process mapping with stakeholders
Data model and architecture design
Iterative build with staging environment
User acceptance testing
Migration, launch, and training

services.title: UI/UX & System Redesign
services.shortDescription: A hard look at your existing site, app, or internal system, followed by a redesign that fixes what's actually costing you users or time.
services.valueProp: Most redesigns fail because they change the look without fixing the workflow. We audit what's actually broken first, then redesign around real usage, not guesswork.
services.problem: An aging site or internal tool that's slow, confusing, or was never designed for how the business actually works today, and needs more than a fresh coat of paint.
deliverables: UX audit of the current site, app, or system
Migration plan that protects existing data and SEO
Updated component system for consistent future changes
approach: Audit: map what's broken, slow, or confusing in the current build
Redesign: new UI/UX and structure based on real usage, not guesswork
Rebuild: implement in a typed, component-based stack
Migrate: move content and data across without breaking what works
Launch: staged rollout with before/after comparison

faq.question: Do we lose our existing content or SEO rankings?
faq.answer: No. Migration is planned around preserving URLs, redirects, and existing content, so search rankings carry over rather than reset.

faq.question: What if we just want a visual refresh, not a full rebuild?
faq.answer: That's fine. The audit tells us how deep the problem actually goes; some projects only need new UI on the existing structure.

services.title: AI Development
services.shortDescription: LLM-powered features and automation that save your team time and make your product smarter for users.
services.valueProp: AI integrated where it meaningfully improves your workflow or product, with clear boundaries between AI integration and custom ML.
services.problem: It can be hard to tell which "AI-powered" claims are backed by real engineering and which are just a thin wrapper, so knowing exactly what you're getting matters.
deliverables: Evaluation and monitoring for AI features
approach: Feasibility and readiness assessment
Architecture design (integration vs custom model)
Build with evaluation harness
Staged rollout with monitoring
Tuning and iteration post-launch

services.title: UI/UX Design
services.shortDescription: Interface design that makes your product easier to use, helping customers complete what they came to do.
services.valueProp: Design measured by real usability and task completion, so it performs well beyond a static mockup.
services.problem: Designs that look impressive but overlook usability, accessibility, or build cost often lead to expensive rework later.
approach: Research and user flows
Wireframing and prototyping
Visual design and design system
Usability validation
Developer handoff

services.title: Maintenance & Support
services.shortDescription: Ongoing care that keeps your site or system secure, fast, and reliable long after launch.
services.valueProp: A direct line to the people who built your system, so issues get fixed by people who already understand the codebase.
services.problem: Sites and systems left unmaintained accumulate security risk, broken integrations, and slow performance regression over time.
approach: Audit current system health
Set up monitoring and alerting
Define SLA and response times
Ongoing maintenance cycle
Quarterly review and roadmap

services.title: Digital Marketing
services.shortDescription: SEO, paid ads, and social media management that bring the right customers to your business consistently.
services.valueProp: A marketing setup that brings the right people to your business consistently, with the follow-through to turn that traffic into results.
services.problem: It's common to run ads, post on social, and still struggle to tell which channel is actually driving revenue without a clear strategy tying it together.
deliverables: Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign setup and management
Ongoing social media post creation, scheduling, and community replies
Monthly analytics report with actionable insights
approach: Audit current digital presence and competitors
Define target audience and channel priorities
Build and launch campaigns with tracking in place
Optimise weekly based on data
Monthly review and roadmap

faq.question: How long before I see results?
faq.answer: SEO typically shows traction in 3-6 months. Paid ads can deliver leads from week one. We set realistic expectations per channel in the initial strategy call.

faq.question: Do you manage ads or just set them up?
faq.answer: We do both: setup and ongoing management with weekly optimisation. One-time setup without management rarely performs well.

services.title: Business Growth
services.shortDescription: Growth strategy and go-to-market planning that helps you reach the right customers at the right time.
services.valueProp: A clear, executable growth plan built around your actual market and stage, so you grow in the direction that makes sense for your business.
services.problem: Knowing what to build is often the easy part. Positioning it, pricing it, and reaching the right customers at the right time is where most startups and SMEs need the most help.
approach: Discovery: understand your business, customers, and market
Research: competitive landscape and positioning gaps
Strategy: define positioning, channels, and targets
Plan: 90-day execution roadmap with milestones
Review: measure, iterate, and re-plan quarterly

faq.question: Is this consulting or execution?
faq.answer: Primarily strategy and planning, but we stay involved through the execution phase to make sure the plan is actually implemented. We don't hand you a deck and disappear.

faq.question: Do you work with pre-revenue startups?
faq.answer: Yes. The approach adjusts: pre-revenue focuses on validation and GTM; post-revenue focuses on scaling what's working and fixing what's not.

services.title: Branding & Identity
services.shortDescription: Brand identity and visuals that help your business look consistent and trustworthy everywhere customers find you.
services.valueProp: A brand that looks consistent, professional, and intentional at every touchpoint, from your logo to your product shots to your Instagram grid.
services.problem: Inconsistent visuals, DIY logos, and low-quality product photos undermine trust before a customer even reads your copy.
deliverables: Logo design and brand identity system
Social media post templates (Canva or Figma)
approach: Brand discovery: values, audience, and reference direction
Concept design: 2-3 directions presented
Refinement: one direction developed to completion
Photography: styling, shoot, and post-processing
Handover: all source files and brand guide

faq.question: Do I get source files?
faq.answer: Yes, all final files in AI, EPS, PNG, and SVG formats, plus your brand guide as a PDF and editable Figma/Canva templates.

faq.question: Can you do product photography outside a studio?
faq.answer: Yes. We do studio tabletop shoots for products and on-location shoots where the environment adds to the story.

services.title: Product Photoshoot & Marketing
services.shortDescription: Professional product photography and campaigns that help your products look great and sell faster.
services.valueProp: Studio-quality product shots and the campaign to match, with one team handling the shoot, the creative, and the ads, so your visuals actually sell.
services.problem: Great products lose sales to bad photos, and even good photos sit unused because nobody turns them into ads, listings, and social content that convert.
deliverables: Retouched, e-commerce-ready images (white background, lifestyle, detail shots)
Ad creatives and social media posts built from the shoot
Campaign setup and management using the new visuals
approach: Brief: product, audience, and platform requirements
Shoot planning: styling, props, and shot list
Photoshoot: studio tabletop or on-location
Post-production: retouch, colour, and platform exports
Marketing: launch ads and content using the new assets

faq.question: Do I need to send my products to you?
faq.answer: For studio shoots, yes: we arrange collection or delivery within the Klang Valley. For bulky products or venue-based businesses, we shoot on-location at your premises.

faq.question: Can I use the photos anywhere?
faq.answer: Yes. You receive full usage rights to all final images, delivered in high resolution plus web-optimised and platform-specific crops.

services.title: Media Creation
services.shortDescription: Video and visual content that helps your business capture attention and hold it, on every platform.
services.valueProp: Polished video and visual content built for how people actually consume, from short-form for social to long-form for YouTube and product demos for sales.
services.problem: Businesses know they need video content but lack the production quality, editing, or consistency to build an audience or convert viewers.
deliverables: Long-form video (YouTube, website hero, product demos)
approach: Brief: define content goals, audience, and platform
Pre-production: scripting, storyboard, scheduling
Production: shoot or record (studio / on-location / screen capture)
Post-production: edit, colour, audio, graphics
Delivery: optimised exports per platform

faq.question: Do you shoot on-site or remotely?
faq.answer: Both. On-site for product, brand, and interview content; remote/screen-capture for tutorials, SaaS demos, and webinars.

faq.question: How many revisions are included?
faq.answer: Two rounds of edit revisions are included per video. We structure briefs well upfront to reduce revision cycles.

services.title: Grant & Government Project Support
services.shortDescription: Grant application support plus the funded digital project itself, helping your business access funding and put it to work.
services.valueProp: One partner to help you apply for the right digitalisation grant, then build the exact digital project the grant is funding, on time and to spec.
services.problem: SME digitalisation grants require both paperwork and a real, working digital deliverable, and most applicants struggle to execute the technical side once funding is approved.
deliverables: Grant eligibility review and application support
Scoped project proposal matching the grant's requirements
The funded website, system, or digital tool, built and delivered
Compliance documentation for disbursement and audit
Support through the grant's reporting period
approach: Assess: which grant fits your business and project
Apply: prepare the application and supporting documents
Build: deliver the digital project the grant is funding
Report: documentation and evidence for compliance
Support: assistance through the reporting window

faq.question: Which grants do you work with?
faq.answer: Malaysian SME digitalisation grants such as Geran Digital PMKS and the MADANI SME Digitalisation Grant, along with other schemes your business may qualify for.

faq.question: Do you help with the grant application itself?
faq.answer: Yes. We help assess eligibility and prepare the application, then deliver the actual digital project once the grant is approved.

services.title: Business Startup Package
services.shortDescription: Brand, website, systems, and a first marketing push, bundled together to help new businesses launch with everything in place.
services.valueProp: A single team handling your logo, your website, the systems to run day-to-day operations, and the marketing push to get your first customers.
services.problem: First-time founders end up hiring several different freelancers for logo, website, and ads, and none of it looks or works like one coherent business.
deliverables: Brand identity: logo, colours, and basic guidelines
Simple ordering, booking, or inventory system, if needed
Social media setup and first content batch
Launch marketing push (ads or organic campaign)
approach: Discovery: your business idea, budget, and timeline
Foundation: brand identity and website
Systems: whatever operational tool your business needs to run
Launch: social presence and first marketing push
Handover: a business that is live, branded, and ready for customers
tools: Branding, web, systems, and marketing stack, combined

faq.question: What if I only need some of this, not everything?
faq.answer: That's fine. The package is a starting bundle. We'll scope it down or up to match what your business actually needs.

faq.question: How long does a full launch package take?
faq.answer: Most startup packages take 4 to 8 weeks depending on scope, from first discovery call to a live, branded business.

services.title: IoT Solutions & Infrastructure
services.shortDescription: Connected devices and sensor networks, wired into a dashboard so you can monitor and act on real-world data.
services.valueProp: Hardware and software scoped together from the start, so sensor data actually reaches a dashboard or workflow you can use, not just a device that blinks.
services.problem: IoT projects often stall at the gap between the hardware and the software, where sensor data is collected but never turned into something a business can actually act on.
deliverables: Sensor and device selection & wiring plan
approach: Requirements & device audit
Architecture design (edge vs cloud processing)
Hardware setup and firmware/integration build
Dashboard and alerting build
Field testing and handover

services.title: Custom Machine Learning Model
services.shortDescription: A model trained on your own data for the specific prediction or classification problem generic AI tools can't solve out of the box.
services.valueProp: Off-the-shelf AI APIs cover general tasks well, but a model trained on your own data handles the specific edge cases that matter to your business.
services.problem: Generic AI tools plateau once your use case gets specific: predicting your churn, classifying your documents, scoring your leads.
deliverables: Deployment as an API your app can call
Monitoring for model drift over time
approach: Define the prediction target and success metric
Prepare and validate training data
Train, evaluate, and tune the model
Deploy behind an API
Monitor and retrain as new data comes in

services.title: AI Chatbot
services.shortDescription: A chatbot that actually knows your business, answering from your real docs, pricing, and policies instead of generic responses.
services.valueProp: Grounded in your own content via retrieval, so answers come from what's actually true about your business, not a generic model guessing.
services.problem: Generic chatbot widgets give generic answers. Customers ask specific questions about your pricing, policies, or product, and get vague replies.
deliverables: Chatbot grounded in your docs, FAQs, and policies (RAG)
Escalation to a human when the bot can't help
approach: Collect and structure the source content the bot should answer from
Build the retrieval pipeline and prompt design
Integrate into your site or WhatsApp
Test against real customer questions
Launch with human escalation and logging

services.title: AI Analytics
services.shortDescription: Dashboards and reports that surface what's actually happening in your business, not just raw numbers you still have to interpret.
services.valueProp: Turns raw operational or sales data into plain-language insights and forecasts, so you spend less time interpreting spreadsheets.
services.problem: Data is scattered across tools and spreadsheets, and by the time someone compiles it into a report, the insight is already stale.
deliverables: Data pipeline connecting your existing tools
Dashboard with the metrics that matter to your business
AI-generated plain-language summaries and trend flags
Scheduled reports to email or WhatsApp
approach: Identify the decisions the dashboard needs to support
Connect and clean data from existing sources
Build the dashboard and summary layer
Validate numbers against your existing reports
Launch with scheduled delivery

services.title: Automation, Workforce & Task
services.shortDescription: Automating the repetitive admin work (data entry, follow-ups, approvals) that's currently eating your team's time.
services.valueProp: We map the actual repetitive steps your team does by hand first, then automate only what's worth automating, not automation for its own sake.
services.problem: Repetitive manual tasks (data entry, follow-up messages, approval routing) quietly eat hours every week and don't scale as the business grows.
deliverables: Workflow audit of current manual processes
Automated pipelines connecting your existing tools
Handover documentation your team can maintain
approach: Map current manual workflows and pain points
Prioritize which steps are worth automating
Build the automation and integrations
Test alongside the team doing the work today
Launch with documentation and handover

services.title: Computer Vision
services.shortDescription: Systems that read images and video feeds directly, for quality checks, counting, tracking, or detection that manual review can't keep up with.
services.valueProp: Cameras and image data become a live data source your systems can act on, instead of footage someone has to watch manually.
services.problem: Manual visual inspection (quality checks, counting stock, watching security footage) doesn't scale and is easy to get wrong when someone's tired or distracted.
deliverables: Object detection, counting, or classification pipeline
Integration with existing cameras or image sources
Real-time alerts when something is detected
approach: Define exactly what needs to be detected or measured
Collect and label sample images/video
Train and evaluate the vision model
Integrate with your camera feed or image pipeline
Deploy with alerting and a review dashboard
